prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and muscle gain through optimized protein distribution and post-workout recovery nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals
Protein distributed evenly across meals (minimum 30g per meal)
Includes dedicated post-workout meal with carbohydrates and protein within 2 hours of training
Total daily protein meets or exceeds 2.2g per kilogram of body weight
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with specific macronutrient ratios (high protein), ensuring the plan emphasizes protein distribution across meals and includes recovery nutrition post-workout

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
All meals are vegan with plant-based protein sources (legumes, nuts, seeds, tofu)
Includes adequate carbohydrates for endurance cycling fuel and recovery
Addresses key micronutrient gaps (B12, iron, omega-3) through food sources or supplementation notes
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary constraint (vegan endurance cyclist), validating that the meal plan meets performance nutritional needs while accommodating plant-based protein sources and addressing potential micronutrient gaps

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-endurance athlete requiring carbohydrate loading and sustained energy for 20km long run scheduled for 10am

solution_criteria: Meal plan provides 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total energy intake
Pre-training meal (2-3 hours before 10am run) is easily digestible with carbs and minimal fat/fiber
Post-training meal includes protein and carbohydrates for recovery within 30-60 minutes of completion
Plan is compact and fits within a single day format with 3-4 meals/snacks
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading, verifying the meal plan balances energy needs with digestibility timing around training windows
